ValidationRule.description: To close a case must have the following fields completed: Case Origin, Client, Classification, Country, Element, Module, Description and Solution.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c ,"GNC"), SER_Discarded__c = FALSE, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Classification__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( Origin )), ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Country__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Type_GNC__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Subtype_GNC__c )), ISBLANK( Description ), ISBLANK( SER_Solution__c ), ISBLANK( AccountId)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case must have the following fields completed: Case Origin, Client, Classification, Country, Element, Module, Description and Solution.
